schema.text: How do traffic levels and congestion on your route typically affect your walking experience?

options.text: The route is generally quiet or traffic has no influence on my walking experience
I notice the traffic but feel physically separated and safe from it
The traffic is frustrating but does not significantly affect my stress levels or route
Traffic makes me feel constantly anxious or unsafe during my walk
I choose much longer routes or change my travel times specifically to avoid heavy traffic

en.#How do traffic levels and congestion on: How do traffic levels and congestion on your route typically affect your walking experience?
en.#The route is generally quiet or traffic: The route is generally quiet or traffic has no influence on my walking experience
en.#I notice the traffic but feel physicall: I notice the traffic but feel physically separated and safe from it
en.#The traffic is frustrating but does not: The traffic is frustrating but does not significantly affect my stress levels or route
en.#Traffic makes me feel constantly anxiou: Traffic makes me feel constantly anxious or unsafe during my walk
en.#I choose much longer routes or change m: I choose much longer routes or change my travel times specifically to avoid heavy traffic

it.#How do traffic levels and congestion on: In che modo i livelli di traffico e la congestione lungo il percorso influenzano normalmente la tua esperienza a piedi?
it.#The route is generally quiet or traffic: Il percorso è generalmente tranquillo oppure il traffico non influisce sulla mia esperienza a piedi
it.#I notice the traffic but feel physicall: Noto il traffico, ma mi sento fisicamente separato/a e al sicuro
it.#The traffic is frustrating but does not: Il traffico è fastidioso, ma non influisce significativamente sul mio livello di stress o sul percorso
it.#Traffic makes me feel constantly anxiou: Il traffico mi fa sentire costantemente ansioso/a o in pericolo mentre cammino
it.#I choose much longer routes or change m: Scelgo percorsi molto più lunghi o cambio gli orari di viaggio appositamente per evitare il traffico intenso

fr.#How do traffic levels and congestion on: Comment le niveau de trafic et les embouteillages sur votre itinéraire influencent-ils généralement votre expérience à pied ?
fr.#The route is generally quiet or traffic: L’itinéraire est généralement calme ou le trafic n’influence pas mon expérience à pied
fr.#I notice the traffic but feel physicall: Je remarque le trafic, mais je me sens bien séparé(e) de celui-ci et en sécurité
fr.#The traffic is frustrating but does not: Le trafic est gênant, mais il n’augmente pas vraiment mon stress et ne change pas mon itinéraire
fr.#Traffic makes me feel constantly anxiou: Le trafic me fait constamment sentir anxieux(se) ou en danger pendant que je marche
fr.#I choose much longer routes or change m: Je choisis des itinéraires beaucoup plus longs ou je change mes heures de déplacement pour éviter le trafic dense

de.#How do traffic levels and congestion on: Wie beeinflussen Verkehrsmenge und Stau auf Ihrer Strecke normalerweise Ihr Erlebnis beim Gehen?
de.#The route is generally quiet or traffic: Die Strecke ist meist ruhig oder der Verkehr beeinflusst mein Gehen nicht
de.#I notice the traffic but feel physicall: Ich bemerke den Verkehr, fühle mich aber gut davon getrennt und sicher
de.#The traffic is frustrating but does not: Der Verkehr ist störend, beeinflusst meinen Stress oder meine Route aber kaum
de.#Traffic makes me feel constantly anxiou: Der Verkehr führt dazu, dass ich mich beim Gehen ständig ängstlich oder unsicher fühle
de.#I choose much longer routes or change m: Ich wähle deutlich längere Wege oder ändere meine Zeiten, um starken Verkehr zu vermeiden

tr.#How do traffic levels and congestion on: Güzergâhınızdaki trafik yoğunluğu ve sıkışıklık yürüme deneyiminizi genellikle nasıl etkiler?
tr.#The route is generally quiet or traffic: Güzergâh genellikle sakindir veya trafik yürüme deneyimimi etkilemez
tr.#I notice the traffic but feel physicall: Trafiği fark ederim ama fiziksel olarak ondan ayrılmış ve güvende hissederim
tr.#The traffic is frustrating but does not: Trafik can sıkıcıdır ama stresimi veya güzergâhımı önemli ölçüde etkilemez
tr.#Traffic makes me feel constantly anxiou: Trafik yürürken sürekli kaygılı veya güvensiz hissetmeme neden olur
tr.#I choose much longer routes or change m: Yoğun trafikten kaçınmak için çok daha uzun güzergâhlar seçer veya yolculuk saatimi değiştiririm

fa.#How do traffic levels and congestion on: حجم ترافیک و ازدحام در مسیر شما معمولاً چگونه بر تجربه پیاده‌روی اثر می‌گذارد؟
fa.#The route is generally quiet or traffic: مسیر معمولاً آرام است یا ترافیک بر تجربه پیاده‌روی من اثری ندارد
fa.#I notice the traffic but feel physicall: ترافیک را می‌بینم، اما احساس می‌کنم از آن جدا و در امنیت هستم
fa.#The traffic is frustrating but does not: ترافیک آزاردهنده است، اما استرس یا مسیرم را خیلی تغییر نمی‌دهد
fa.#Traffic makes me feel constantly anxiou: ترافیک باعث می‌شود هنگام پیاده‌روی دائماً احساس اضطراب یا ناامنی کنم
fa.#I choose much longer routes or change m: برای دوری از ترافیک سنگین مسیر بسیار طولانی‌تر انتخاب می‌کنم یا زمان سفرم را تغییر می‌دهم

hu.#How do traffic levels and congestion on: Hogyan befolyásolja általában a forgalom és a torlódás a gyalogos élményét az útvonalán?
hu.#The route is generally quiet or traffic: Az útvonal általában nyugodt, vagy a forgalom nem befolyásolja a gyaloglási élményemet
hu.#I notice the traffic but feel physicall: Észreveszem a forgalmat, de fizikailag elkülönülve és biztonságban érzem magam
hu.#The traffic is frustrating but does not: A forgalom zavaró, de nem befolyásolja jelentősen a stresszemet vagy az útvonalamat
hu.#Traffic makes me feel constantly anxiou: A forgalom miatt gyaloglás közben folyamatosan szorongónak vagy bizonytalannak érzem magam
hu.#I choose much longer routes or change m: Jelentősen hosszabb útvonalat választok vagy módosítom az utazási időt, hogy elkerüljem az erős forgalmat

ar.#How do traffic levels and congestion on: كيف تؤثر كثافة حركة المرور والازدحام على طريقك عادةً في تجربة المشي؟
ar.#The route is generally quiet or traffic: الطريق هادئ عادةً أو حركة المرور لا تؤثر في تجربة المشي
ar.#I notice the traffic but feel physicall: ألاحظ حركة المرور لكنني أشعر أنني منفصل عنها وآمن
ar.#The traffic is frustrating but does not: حركة المرور مزعجة لكنها لا تؤثر كثيرًا في مستوى التوتر أو الطريق
ar.#Traffic makes me feel constantly anxiou: حركة المرور تجعلني أشعر باستمرار بالقلق أو عدم الأمان أثناء المشي
ar.#I choose much longer routes or change m: أختار طرقًا أطول بكثير أو أغيّر وقت الرحلة لتجنب حركة المرور الكثيفة
